thread:
Taylor: FYI customer Atlas surfaced a firm ask: private deployment by EoQ with an SLA target 99.9% + p95 <150ms for chat. they want KMS + 1yr audit retention and a staged canary rollout. need cross-team tradeoffs and owners. who volunteers to map constraints?

Ravi: I can take runtime sequencing + perf plan. need expected steady qps and tail prompt length distributions. also whether Atlas will accept a model-variant fallback for tails.

Taylor: steady ~100 qps, onboarding peaks up to 450 qps for short windows. median prompt ~150 tokens, 99th ~900. fallback acceptable for <1% of requests if we clearly document behavior.

Lila: infra note: we can give dedicated pool in the customer's VPC. tradeoff is warm vs standby. warm nodes reduce cold-starts but cost more. need a prewarm SLA from runtime.

Noor: security: KMS + optional HSM, VPC peering, SCIM provisioning for SSO, and audit retention policy. legal wants a mapping of logs -> PII redaction plan before agreeing to 1yr retention.

Diego: from solutions: Atlas will want an onboarding window where we accept higher latency for heavy initial imports. can we gate that to a known maintenance window? simplifies SLA acceptance.

Ravi: perf estimates: baseline quantized model + 8xA100 equiv hits target for median; p95 needs autoscale with ~45s scale-up unless we use prewarmed nodes. I'll prototype batch thresholds and KV-prefetch patterns this week.

Taylor: proposed minimal gating flow:
- Contract: privacy addendum + SLO appendix
- Infra: dedicated pool reserved in staging (2w validation)
- Security: threat model + KMS integration test
- Perf: 72h canary at 5% traffic then ramp with rollback windows

Lila: infra tasks:
- cost estimate warm vs standby by Thu
- reserve "atlas-stg-1755" cluster (4 prewarmed) - done pending billing
- automation: fast-attach flow for standby nodes (P0)

Noor: security tasks:
- KMS integration plan (owner: Noor)
- log retention policy draft for legal (owner: Noor + legal)
- threat model + mitigations by Tue

Ravi: runtime tasks:
- perf matrix + test harness (deliverable: perf matrix doc)
- prewarm SLA requirement (what we need from infra)
- fallback model integration tests

Diego: customer coordination:
- confirm maintenance window for heavy imports
- signoff on fallback behavior

Taylor: owners recap: Taylor (PM), Ravi (runtime), Lila (infra), Noor (security), Diego (customer lead).

Quick ask: each owner drop a 3-bullet checklist in this thread by EOD tomorrow. i'll compile and send to Atlas.

ci-bot: created staging cluster "atlas-stg-1755" (4 prewarm slots) at 2024-11-16T09:12:03Z.

Ravi: will post perf matrix tonight. initial hypothesis: 8 GPUs + continuous batching + 50ms kv-prefetch hits p95 under steady; bursts need autoscale tuning.

Lila: noted. if runtime requires <10s cold-start we should plan for 6 prewarmed nodes for safety. will include cost delta in the estimate. :bar_chart:

Noor: flagging legal: @legal can you advise on PII retention constraints for Atlas (finance customer)? need answer for 1yr vs 90d.

Taylor: thanks all. keep updates here and we'll do a quick 15min sync tomorrow if owners post checklists. :calendar:
